name: Cobalt Throne

stars.name: Cobalt Throne
stars.notes: Young, intensely luminous B-class star, bathes the system in hard ultraviolet radiation

planets.name: Cruciform
planets.notes: Tidally locked cinder, dayside surface temperature exceeds 2,400K, metals exist as liquid pools

planets.name: Slag
planets.notes: Intense UV bombardment drives exotic photochemistry in volcanic plumes, potential industrial feedstock

planets.name: Bastion
planets.notes: Dense iron-core world with powerful magnetic field, only planet with meaningful radiation shielding

planets.name: Azuriel
planets.notes: Brilliant blue gas giant, helium-rich atmosphere, three moons host automated mining rigs

planets.name: Frostmantle
planets.notes: Distant ice giant with nitrogen-methane atmosphere, rings of frozen debris visible from inner system

anomalies.name: The Blue Scream
anomalies.notes: Intense stellar flare zone producing periodic gamma-ray bursts, lethal to unshielded ships within minutes

asteroid_belts.name: Crown Debris
asteroid_belts.notes: Extraordinarily metal-rich belt, primary source of titanium and tungsten for sector military production

asteroid_belts.name: Outer Scatter
asteroid_belts.notes: Diffuse field of ice and rock, occasional comet origins

stations.name: Fort Cobalt
stations.notes: Heavily fortified military installation, controls access to strategic mineral extraction operations

stations.name: Bastion Relay
stations.notes: Communications hub and waystation, sheltered within Bastion's magnetic field

faction_control.notes: Classified military zone, civilian access restricted to approved contractors and resupply convoys

history: Surveyed in 2411 and initially dismissed due to extreme radiation, the system was reclassified as strategically vital in 2498 when Crown Debris was found to contain the densest tungsten deposits in the sector.
Terran Naval Command established Fort Cobalt in 2512, transforming the system into a restricted military extraction zone supplying warship armor and weapons manufacturing.

A failed sabotage attempt by unknown agents in 2674 destroyed three automated mining platforms and killed 47 personnel, prompting a permanent naval garrison and ongoing counterintelligence operations.
description: Cobalt Throne blazes with the furious blue-white light of a young B-class star, its radiation so intense that the inner system is essentially sterilized. Five worlds orbit at respectful distances—scorched rock, volcanic fury, dense iron, a brilliant blue giant, and a distant ice world ringed in frozen debris. Nothing lives here naturally, and nothing ever will; the star's ultraviolet output would strip any atmosphere thin enough to breathe within geological moments.

What the system lacks in habitability it compensates in raw materials. Crown Debris, the dense metallic asteroid belt between Bastion and Azuriel, contains tungsten and titanium concentrations unmatched anywhere in the Scorpius Reach. Terran Naval Command recognized the strategic implications immediately and locked the system down. Fort Cobalt's mining operations run around the clock, feeding ore to warship foundries across Terran space. Traffic is light but heavily screened—every vessel entering the system is tracked, scanned, and escorted.

The 2674 sabotage raised questions that remain unanswered. No faction claimed responsibility, and the sophistication of the attack suggested state-level resources. Naval Intelligence maintains an active investigation, but the trail has gone cold. Some officers at Fort Cobalt believe the saboteurs were after something specific in the deeper strata of Crown Debris—not tungsten, but something else entirely, buried beneath the metal-rich surface layers. Drilling teams have reported anomalous density readings at depth, but their findings remain classified.
